Proof

\sketch The identity $\langle X_j,N angle =0$ implies

\[ 0=\left\langle \partial _i\partial _jX,N ight angle +\left\langle X_j,\overline abla _{X_i}N ight angle . \]

The Weingarten equation gives $\overline abla _{X_i}N=-s(X_i)$, so the second term is $-h(X_j,X_i)$, proving (8.23).
